scope: Owner requested fixes to chat findings 3 (draft loading/listing) and 4 (road generation/invalidation). Original JSON review priorities combined the earlier object/save findings, so these correspond to JSON review entries 2 and 3.

draft_loading: Draft gallery immediately builds its controls and scans saved/WIP documents plus tested/publication summaries on a cancellable low-priority worker. Directory, library revision and profile scope guards discard stale scans. Closing the page never joins its live scan.

A 32 MiB/1024-entry immutable binary cache avoids repeated JSON parse/validation and summary fingerprinting. Every hit hashes the actual current file bytes, detecting external and same-size edits; decoded documents own independent mutable values.

Cards retain only names/themes/piece outlines/counts/fingerprints. Full authoring documents load lazily for the selected actions. Primary/backup/temp precedence, saved/WIP ordering and publication locks are retained. Reads no longer reread documents just for timestamps; cold summary decoding reuses its first file buffer.
Successful WIP writes/deletes increment the parent library revision. Lifecycle readers share existing recovery/schema validation while static worker reads avoid accessing live UI/network nodes.
roads: Low-priority road jobs produce CPU-only triangle/index/normal/UV/colour arrays. ArrayMesh upload, texture/material binding and scene publication remain on the main thread with existing frame slicing.

Cold road generation is separate from the compiler worker joined by Undo/profile transitions. Compilation can attach an already prepared packet or just its dependency key; foreground callers also defer cold geometry to the road job.

A conservative geometry digest uses visual version, biome, road pieces/surface/base source, extent/cell size, canonical kerb triangles and Desert road occupancy. Metadata and irrelevant prop/paint edits can reuse the actual immutable road meshes. Geometry/width/extent/surface/biome/road-occupancy changes invalidate as needed.

Document hashes and disk cache contracts remain canonical. Reused materials are duplicated per original shared material and rebind shared current overlay/road/exclusion textures, keeping older scenes intact. Prepared CPU arrays and the existing GPU road cache share its original 32 MiB allowance.
Faithfully emulates the pinned engine intermediate normal/colour packing so worker arrays retain the original renderer pixels. Exact original bank branch forms and shader inputs are retained.

diagnostic_history: Initial probe recovery assertion lacked a real backup. Saving the fixture twice created the intended previous committed state; the original recovery assertion then passed.

Mesh equivalence initially exposed intermediate engine normal and colour quantization. The CPU preparation now reproduces that exact packing; final assertions use exact mesh arrays and image bytes, without tolerance relaxation.

A race-only original reference initially entered concurrent spatial-mesh work. Both paired road fixtures now explicitly use the actual editor path; concurrent unnamed-chunk fixes were preserved and excluded.

An existing publication fixture completed gate sweeps at an unchanging simulation tick, incompatible with current trajectory-only completion. It now timestamps its actual synthetic movement. Its obsolete disabled-Publish assertion now verifies that local evidence enables explicit Publish without minting a publication; the existing guest/no-cloud-publication and persisted-completion assertions remain.

One final Compatibility/parser attempt encountered a concurrently unfinished CompactDetail.rim_detail API. After that unrelated edit became consistent, both reruns passed. No car-model edit belongs to this task.
